jobs.title: Premio: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Description Premio is searching for a new Product Manager to join our growing talented team. With Premio, you’ll be able to manage some of our products used by over 700,000 websites worldwide and has gotten thousands of 5 star reviews. You’ll be working with us on SaaS products, Shopify apps, WordPress plugins, and Wix apps. The main product we’re working on is Chatway , a SaaS product used by businesses worldwide with thousands of 5-star reviews. You’ll be expected to do the following: Work closely with engineering, QA, marketing, and support teams to ensure business case and customer satisfaction goals are met. Determine new and existing feature requirements. Identify and fill product gaps. Create UI wireframes for new features. Task management. Execution of existing workflow. Product testing. Work with the feedback from users (external and internal) to make products better. Requirements Product management experience (SaaS/Micro-SaaS) Highly effective cross-functional team management. Good understanding of WordPress, Shopify and other CMS platforms. Ability to communicate ideas clearly, write intelligently, and enjoy working with a passionate team. Keen eye for design with experience using wireframe tools such as Whimsical, Figma, Balsamiq, etc. A proactive approach to problem-solving with strong decision-making skills. Coding experience – Nice to have Marketing background – Nice to have
